ones, there are two useful options: Load accounts — this option allows you to load accounts into the software, but it only works with accounts in Json+Session format. To add accounts, place the account files in the Active folder, located in the TelegramExpert\sessions\active directory, and then refresh the page in the software using F5 or click on «Active Accounts». All profiles will appear in the software. Search — this function allows you to search for a specific account. If the user has hundreds of accounts but needs to find one specific account, this function will save a lot of time. It searches across all account data — numbers, names, usernames, etc. Next to the search, you can specify the number of accounts to display on one page. You can leave it at 50 or set it to display up to 1000. Account panel — this is a powerful tool that allows the user to fully control their accounts, manage them easily, and monitor their status. Everything is designed to be simple and convenient, even when working with a large number of accounts!
